So this mechanism was recorded DORMANT but was reachable; it is fixed, not merely re-argued. Pinned in test/test_card_generation_pool.py.  The text it replaced read: `public override bool CanBeGeneratedInCombat => false` (Disintegration.cs:16) has no counterpart: the sim leaves `can_be_generated_in_combat` at its True default and instead turns OFF a DIFFERENT flag, `can_be_generated_by_modifiers`, which Disintegration.cs does not override at all (C# leaves it `=> true`, CardModel.cs:648). Two mismatched flags in one card. DORMANT both ways: the in-combat generators the first flag gates (Infernal Blade, Discovery, Jack of All Trades, Distraction) all draw from `pool_card_ids()`, which is built from IRONCLAD_POOL and contains no Status cards, and the second flag gates the random-CURSE pool, which a Status of Status rarity is not in either. Live for the first flag the moment any in-combat generator is pointed at a pool that includes statuses.

ctor.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign): `Card.energy_cost` (`sts2_rl/cards/base.py`) now short-circuits on `self._energy_cost < 0` as its first check, returning the raw canonical value before consulting `_free_this_turn` / `_cost_this_turn` / `_cost_this_combat` / `_cost_delta_this_turn` -- mirrors `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers`'s `if (_base < 0) return num;` short-circuit (`CardEnergyCost.cs:101-104`; the record's `:100-103` cite is one line of decompiler drift), which runs before any local or global modifier. All 29 unplayable curse/status/quest cards now set `self._energy_cost = -1` in `_init_vars` (previously 0), each verified individually against its own C# `base(-1, CardType.X, ...)` constructor -- no exceptions, no ascension-gated cost variant. Readers audit (every non-cards/ `energy_cost` hit read in context): combat play/auto-play/valid_actions/action-mask sites gate on `is_playable` first and never see -1; every global-modifier site routes through `hooks.modify_card_energy_cost`, whose dispatcher ends `return max(0, cost)` -- the sim's analogue of C#'s `Math.Max(0, GetWithModifiers(...))` in `GetAmountToSpend`/`GetResolved` (`CardEnergyCost.cs:134-141`) -- so what is SPENT and what the observation encoder reads (`full_env.py` card_features via `previews.py` preview_card_energy_cost) are byte-for-byte unchanged. The three previously-known readers (`relics/mummified_hand.py`, `potions.py` TouchOfInsanity, `cards/event_cards.py` Enlightenment) remain correct, confirmed by unit tests. NOT closed here: `selectors.py`'s `scripted_card_selector` 'to_draw_top' purpose (Headbutt/Thinking Ahead) ranks by raw `card.energy_cost` unclamped -- a sim-only heuristic with no C# analogue; a curse in a Headbutt-eligible discard pile now ranks below-cost instead of tying at 0. No test exercises it; filed in GAP-QUEUE.md's 'Named work with no entry of its own'. New pins: test/test_unplayable_cost.py (15 tests).  The text it replaced read: STATUS / STATUS / NONE map exactly, and the sim's shared `_ChoosableCurse` base carries them for all four Knowledge-Demon cards. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier and keeps reporting -1; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). `GetAmountToSpend()` clamps to Math.Max(0, ...) on both sides, so only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: the ported cost readers all filter `> 0` or skip `<= 1` (relics/mummified_hand.py:25, potions.py:168, cards/event_cards.py:328), and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses or statuses.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<DisintegrationPower>(6m)` (Disintegration.cs:18) == `default_power_amount = 6`, copied into `self.power_amount` by `_init_vars` so it is re-seeded on downgrade. The sim's comment notes the amount scales 6/7/8 with the Curse of Knowledge counter, which is the Knowledge Demon's business, not the card's.

OnChosen.maps_to: _ChoosableCurse's power application via CombatState.select_cards (knowledge_curses.py module docstring; the applier is the Knowledge Demon monster)
OnChosen.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<DisintegrationPower>(new ThrowingPlayerChoiceContext(), Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["DisintegrationPower"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Disintegration.cs:25-28) == the sim's select-then-apply path, which reads `power_cls` and `power_amount` off the chosen card and applies it to the player. Self-target, self-applier, amount 6 on both sides. `KnowledgeDemon.IChoosable` is an interface, not a CardModel override, so the harness's `public override` scan does not enumerate it -- added by hand.

OnPlay.rationale: Disintegration.cs declares no OnPlay, so playing it would do nothing. See the guard for the playability flag.
